name: Compress Guidance (CFG form, reconstructed)
plain: Runs guidance only on some steps and scales it by the gap. Docstring labels this as a reconstruction since the paper gives only the classifier form.
math: guided step: w_eff = 1+(w−1)L_i; L_i=steps until next guided step; other steps w=1
